svg.title: Foundations: color roles, type and iconography (Era 3)
svg.desc: Layer 1 perceptual foundations for WFS Family Cookbook Era 3.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 (Dual-Mode)
Dual-mode semantic tokens (:root Standard AA default vs. :root[data-contrast="high"] AAA) over immutable ramps.
1 · Warm espresso-ink charcoal ramp & cream canvas
* Standard AA: ink-body 800 (#28231F), ink-muted 500 (#6E645B), chrome-line 200 (#E5DFD7). High AAA: 900 (#191512), 600 (#524A43), 500 (#6E645B).
2 · Dual-mode semantic role matrix (Standard AA default → High Contrast AAA)
Hearth · Standard AA → High Contrast AAA
Quiet #E6B3A9 line in Standard; crisp #A44A37 border in High.
High border sharpens to #8F6D01; never place text on bg-ochre.
Garden · Cooled Herb Roles (#4E6E52 / #3D5940 Standard AA → #324D36 / #243A27 High Contrast AAA)
Cooled herb replaces olive sage-600/700 for crisp green-vs-red hue separation against Hearth while keeping sage-50/100
tints (High Contrast garden-ink #324D36 reaches 8.34:1 on sage-50, 7.41:1 on sage-100, and 9.33:1 on white).
3 · Retired / disallowed pairings vs. Standard AA role repairs
Checked continuously by tokens.test.ts + visual-contract.test.ts + visual-a11y-contract.ts ('aa' and 'aaa').
4 · Type scale, context-paired Ready in, 48px targets & focus
Ready in pill (sentence case everywhere · context-paired):
24px glyph inside >= 48 x 48 CSS px box
5 · Bottom navigation (.glass-nav vs. opaque High Contrast) & Lucide icons
Standard .glass-nav uses translucent frosted cream; :root[data-contrast="high"] switches to opaque #FDFCF0 + #6E645B top border.
Companion boards: 02 Surfaces, Controls & Recovery · 03 Supper Plan & Week · 04 Recipe Cards & Detail.
